name: Barnabas Horton
bioAdditions: Horton Genealogy (1876) gives Barnabas as son of Joseph Horton, b. Mowsley, Leicestershire, 13 July 1600. It says he came in the Swallow (Jeremy Horton master), landed at Hampton, Mass., went to New Haven in 1640 with his wife Mary and sons Joseph and Benjamin, and settled at Southold in Oct 1640 (S1). It does not list a daughter who married William Salmon. Its 'Sarah' is b. c.1653 and m. Joseph Conklin (S1). But the Southold town records state explicitly that William Salmon, after Katherine's death, 'married with Sarah Hortton', and that John Conckelyne Jr. then took 'the said Sarah Salmon' to wife (S2). Recent work (J. Dinan, In Search of Barnabas Horton, via WikiTree) makes her Barnabas's daughter by his first wife Anne Smith, b. c.1635, when he was a baker at Nuneaton, Warwickshire (S3). The Horton Genealogy's Sarah/Joseph Conklin entry looks like a garbled version of the Sarah (Horton) Salmon-John Conklin marriage.
openQuestionsNew: Barnabas's Mowsley baptism: the 13 July 1600 date in Horton 1876 is a birth date with no register citation. Check the Mowsley/Laughton parish register.
